notes:
SWIT QB Companion 2.0.0-beta.63

Reconcile helper: a line’s rule can be changed (and run again at once), swapped for another rule for that line only, turned off for the line, or set back to automatic; Make a new rule works on any line.
Journal entries from a bank line carry the bank’s reference in the memo (e.g. Funds Transfer Fee S92231369).
Also in this version: bank rules can record as a Journal entry or Insurance EOB, apply as soon as they’re made, and name a direct payment’s GL account.

Includes everything from 2.0.0-beta.56 to 62.
